position_overview:
Remote Full-time $1.5K-4K/mo + uncapped performance bonuses

Hey, I'm Yente, co-founder of Primal Storm - primal-storm.com

In 9 months, we went from a $1,000 CPA and zero customers to $1M+/month in revenue. Now we're scaling to $5M/month by December.

We're hiring video editor to help us get there.
key_responsibilities:
What you'll actually do:
- Edit 7-10 ads per week that go straight into real spend.
- Work with UGC, AI clips, and the best raw footage in the men's supplement space.
- See your creatives scale to $10K+/day, or fail fast and learn faster.
- Build toward becoming a creative strategist (this is the path, not the ceiling).

The XP system: Working here is playing a game you can win:

Every ad you ship earns you XP, tied directly to the ad spend it drives. The more XP you build, the higher your level. The higher your level, the bigger your bonus multiplier.

Translation: if your ads perform, your income compounds automatically. No politics. No waiting for a "review." Your work scales, your bonus scales. Period.
qualifications:
Who we're NOT looking for:
- "Brand awareness" editors. We sell. We scale. Everything else is noise.
- 9-to-5ers. We move fast. If a winner hits, we ship.
- People who need hand-holding. We give context, you take ownership.

Who we ARE looking for:
- You study winning DTC ads for fun.
- You'd rather make $4K/mo where your work moves the needle than $8K/mo as just another editor at some agency.
- You want to be the best at this, not just employed in this.
- You're obsessed with the outcome AND the process.

$1.5K-4K/mo base + uncapped bonuses on every winning ad you ship, scaling automatically with your XP level. Top performers compound fast. Path to creative strategist within 12 months for the right person.

Ready to join Primal Storm? Complete the application form to be considered for the role.

Thank you for your interest in joining the Primal Storm team and helping us dominate the eCommerce space together.
